title: Chapter 228: Walking Up The Mountain
content:
Chapter 228: Walking Up The Mountain

At this time, a big news broke out like a bomb in the fairyland.

Suddenly, countless forces were shocked.

All the top strong men in the fairy realm looked at Xiao clan with solemnity.

Twelve peak powerhouses in the Immortal Emperor Realm!

The Xiao clan hid so deeply, but now the Xiao clan chose to expose his strength at this time.

It seems that the Xiao clan is full of expectations for the arrival of that day.

The news is still spreading, and every force is extremely shocked when he hears this news.

For a time, the forces who were visiting the Xiao clan directly lined up.

It can almost line up from one end of the fairyland to another end.

Of course, the fairyland is vast and endless. This statement may be a bit exaggerated, but it is enough to prove the current status of the Xiao clan in the fairyland.

At the same time, Xiao Yin also brought Lu Xue and Xiao Luo to the Tiandi Academy.

At this time, the news of the Xiao clan had not reached here, and the Tiandi Academy was not in conflict with the world, so the news was not very well-versed.

Lu Xue and the other two stood outside the Tiandi Academy.

In front of me, a fairy mountain that entered the sky was like a peerless sword and penetrated into the ground, with awesome momentum.

Above the fairy mountain, the fairy aura is ethereal and the fairyland aura is rich.

Several snow-white and spiritual white cranes flew back and forth from above the fairy mountain, and the sound of reading aloud came from the top of the mountain from time to time, which was full of the aura of a scholar.

And the huge academy at the top of the fairy mountain is the famous Tiandi Academy in the fairyland.

The holy place for reading in the hearts of scholars all over the world.

In this world of cultivation where strength is respected, this academy that subjectively studies and study has undoubtedly become a clear stream.

Xiao Yin looked at the fairy mountain in front of him, and his eyes couldn't help but feel a little dazed.

Lu Xue was curious and waited around.

Only Xiao Luo's heart was pounding inexplicably. After experiencing such a big change in the family, he returned to Tiandi Academy again, and couldn't help but feel that everything had changed a lot.

At this time, Xiao Yin said, "Let's go up."

Hearing this, Lu Xue tilted her head and said in confusion: "Walk up?"

Xiao Yin nodded and then explained: "This is the rule of Tiandi Academy. Those who respect the Academy need to walk up the mountain."

In fact, with Xiao Yin's current strength, he doesn't need to walk up any longer.

Because even if you fly up directly, the academy dares not say anything.

But Xiao Yin did not do this because she always respected the academy.

Back then, if it weren't for the help of the academy, she wouldn't be the same as she is today.

But as if he had thought of something, Xiao Yin looked at Lu Xue hesitantly and said, "Miss Lu, if you don't want to walk up, you can fly up directly."

After all, Lu Xue has his identity. To be honest, it is already an honor for Lu Xue to come to this Tiandi Academy.

On the side, Xiao Luo nodded in agreement.

Seeing this, Lu Xue was about to say something, when Ao Qing suddenly came out of Lu Xue's cuff.

"My master, how can this academy be so generous? I'll let you walk up there. There is a deserted city behind you. Walking up means that our deserted city is not as good as his academy?"

Ao Qing said with a striking look.

In short, in his eyes, Lu Xue has a noble status, so how could she suffer such grievances?

The next moment, Ao Qing turned into the body directly.

Although he deliberately reduced his size, his body was still hundreds of thousands of feet long, with golden scales particularly dazzling, and his blood pressure directly made the cranes on the fairy mountain start flying around, obviously frightened.

"My little master, come up, I'll take you up."

Looking at Ao Qing, Lu Xue hesitated a little and turned her head to look at Xiao Yin and the others.

Xiao Yin smiled and said, "Miss Lu, it's okay."

Hearing this, Lu Xue no longer hesitated. Isn’t it just that she doesn’t walk? What could happen?

"Let's go."

Immediately, Xiao Yin and Xiao Luo walked up the mountain from the foot of the mountain.

Ao Qing took Lu Xue directly into the sky, and in a few breaths he flew directly to the top of the mountain. His huge body hovered in the void, and his dragon pupils, like the scorching sun, stared at the Tiandi Academy below.

It has to be said that although Ao Qing is not strong now, he is very capable.

This appearance is extremely frightening as soon as you look at it.

However, Ao Qing was about to land when an angry shout suddenly sounded from the academy.

"Pride, how dare you offend my academy?!"

The next moment, several immortal master cultivators suddenly appeared in Ao Qing's sight.

When they saw Ao Qing, the eyes of several people were trembling.

Six-clawed true dragon!

But then, the few people were shocked again.

Just because the three of them saw a young woman standing above the dragon's head.

The woman's face looked a little cold, wearing a blue long dress. Even though it was far apart, the chill that overflowed from her body was still deeply touching.

The woman was so beautiful that she was nowhere to be said, she was no less than the flower of her academy.

The six-clawed true dragon fairy world has long disappeared, but now it has appeared again. What’s more important is that the woman in front of her is just the breath of the Immortal Lord realm, but it can make a six-clawed true dragon willing to obey.

Which force is this the eldest lady from?

The few people were a little confused for a moment.

However, Ao Qing in the void looked angry, "Little Lord, they scolded me for being a villain!"

At this time, Lu Xue also had a bad expression.

In her eyes, Ao Qing is not just a pet spirit beast, but a family member.

After years of time and night, it is not as simple as saying.

Lu Xue naturally couldn't bear it when the few people in front of her insulted Ao Qing in front of her.

"Apologize."

Looking at the three academy people in the distance, Lu Xue looked cold and spoke coldly.

Hearing this, the three of them were stunned and then frowned slightly.

"Girl, this is Tiandi Academy. No matter who you are, my Academy,"

"I'll make you apologize!"

Lu Xue still stared at the other party with a cold expression before she could finish her words.

Suddenly, the three of them looked bad.

They naturally understood what Lu Xue meant, but how could it be possible for them to apologize to a dragon in the Tiandi Academy?

Even the six-clawed real dragon cannot do it.

Seeing that the three people in front of him were indifferent, Lu Xue slowly clenched her fists.

My father asked her to come to the academy to study hard, so she didn't want to come to the academy to cause trouble, but now she can't help herself.

If I had encountered such a thing in the past, I could not defeat it, and I would have swallowed my anger and passed.

But now it’s different, Ao Qing is right.

Behind me is the deserted city. Walking outside, it is not only my own face, but also the deserted city.

You must not be timid.

Then, Lu Xue took a deep breath and stomped her feet suddenly.

"Xiaoqing, fuck them!"

Ao Qing had been tolerating the other party for a long time, and when he heard Lu Xue's order, Ao Qing roared directly.

Suddenly, a dragon roar resounded throughout the world.

The powerful dragon power continued to pour out from the huge dragon body.

Seeing Ao Qing rushing towards him and others, the three of them were shocked.

"Bold!"
